reference_solution:
import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n, m, p = data[0], data[1], data[2]
parent = list(range(n + 1))

def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x

pos = 3
for _ in range(m):
    a, b = data[pos], data[pos + 1]
    pos += 2
    ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
    if ra != rb:
        parent[ra] = rb

out = []
for _ in range(p):
    a, b = data[pos], data[pos + 1]
    pos += 2
    out.append('Yes' if find(a) == find(b) else 'No')

print('\n'.join(out))
